virtuosity.notes: Virtuosity Drums (CC0): kick = kick mic + OH, snare/rim = snare mic + OH, hats/cymbals/toms = mid + OH pair; percussion = close + OH (woodblock OH only); bongo = high bongo, congaHigh = conga, congaLow = tumba.

bigRusty.notes: Big Rusty Drums (CC0): close + overhead mics; rim = sidestick, toms = 14in rack and 18in floor, crash 17in, ride 22in. No auxiliary percussion in the kit.

naked.notes: Naked Drums (CC BY 4.0): direct mic + overheads (crash: OH + close room); rim = sidestick (OH only, close mic clips; one dynamic layer, soft = second round robin at -3 dB); toms 1 and 4.

drskit.notes: DRSKit (CC BY 4.0): mono mix of close mic + OH L/R + ambience L/R from the 13-channel hits; rim = snare rimshot; crash = right crash (OH + ambience only); toms 1 and 3 (floor).

retro.notes: Retro Drums 1 (free-use samples): Sequential Drumtraks for snare, rimshot, clap, hats, crash, ride, tambourine and cabasa (as shaker); Casio RZ-1 for kick and toms; Roland CR-8000 for cowbell, congas and claves. Single-velocity machines: soft layer = same hit at -6 dB.

unruly.notes: Unruly Drums (CC0, snare wires on every drum): kick in + out + OH, 14in snare top + OH pair, rim = sidestick, toms = 13in and 22in drums, clean tom articulation, 16in crash, 20in ride, woodblock close + OH.
